sections.label: MFA priorities during COVID-19 crisis
sections.summary: MFA will prioritise looking after Singaporeans overseas, strengthening relations with neighbours and partners, and maintaining global relevance amid COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: In the midst of this unprecedented crisis, we will continue to prioritise these key areas of MFA's work: First, looking after Singaporeans overseas; Second, managing and strengthening relations with our immediate neighbours, ASEAN, and key regional and international partners and; Third, maintaining our relevance on the global stage and engaging our international partners as we embark on our collective fight against COVID-19.

sections.label: Singapore-Malaysia relations and RTS Link
sections.summary: Singapore continues a win-win approach with Malaysia, including the Johor Bahru-Singapore Rapid Transit System Link project both sides agreed to proceed with.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: In our relations with Malaysia, we continue to adopt a win-win approach in the many areas where we have common interests, such as the Johor Bahru-Singapore Rapid Transit System Link project that both sides have agreed to proceed with.

sections.label: Ties beyond Southeast Asia, vaccine multilateralism
sections.summary: Singapore will strengthen political, economic and strategic ties beyond Southeast Asia, exploring cooperation in vaccine multilateralism for early COVID-19 vaccine access.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Beyond Southeast Asia, we will continue to strengthen our political, economic, and strategic ties, and explore new areas of cooperation particularly in vaccine multilateralism, which would be critical to help Singapore secure early and adequate access to COVID-19 vaccines.

sections.label: Multilateral fora, trade, digital, climate, Latin America
sections.summary: Singapore will play a constructive role in multilateral fora, advocate trade liberalisation and vaccine multilateralism, foster safe cyberspace, address global challenges, and pursue FTAs with Latin American blocs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We will continue to play a constructive role at various multilateral fora, including the United Nations, the World Health Organization, and the World Trade Organization.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We will continue to advocate for trade and investment liberalisation, a free, open and rules-based multilateral system, the importance of preserving supply chain connectivity, facilitating the flow of essential goods, and promoting vaccine multilateralism.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: These are critical to Singapore's growth and prosperity.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We will work with partners to foster an environment where individuals, businesses, and governments can transact safely in cyberspace and thereby create opportunities for Singaporeans in the new digital era.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We will also continue to contribute to efforts to address global challenges like climate change and sustainable development and developing global public health protocols and standards.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Latin America is increasingly an important source of food for Singapore, and potentially a growing market for our companies' expertise.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We have embarked on Free Trade Agreement (FTA) negotiations with the Pacific Alliance and MERCOSUR regional blocs to enhance our economic ties.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We will also utilise our Singapore Cooperation Programme (SCP) to support the efforts of developing countries to achieve the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
